method: Adversarial oracle audit. Every TEST/TEST_F body read; each file classified into one dominant oracle category and tallied against 7 named smell patterns with file:line evidence. Seeds verified directly by the lead auditor; the remaining 63 files audited by six parallel sub-auditors and cross-checked. by_smell counts are the number of FILES exhibiting each smell (a file may exhibit several).

per_file.note: SEED CONFIRMED. Deliberate measurement instrument: all 9 TESTs funnel through finishCell() which ends in SUCCEED() (lines 126-131). Internally builds a genuinely strong glyph-quad+pixel oracle (evalTextCell) but NEVER asserts it — corruption is recorded as data. By design for phase-1 discovery, but zero test-failure signal.

Operates on real glyph pixels; interior/exterior preservation and premultiplied-invariant checks (331-353) are true. But most measurement tests assert wide ranges (roughness>10, noise 3-15) and EnrichedAtlas cache test (386) is near-assertion-free.
Shaping is proto-visual but no test verifies glyph IDs or metric-accurate positions; asserts glyph-count==char-count + xAdvance>0. CanRenderReturnsFalseForCJK (95) is (void)result — assertion-free.

Injects H1/P/Figure tags; only asserts boolean pageHasMarkedContent after reopen. Never verifies WHICH tag/MCID/region survived. PreservesRendering checks only pageCount>0; ConstructDestroy is SUCCEED().

STRONG. Asserts exact language codes ("ara"/"eng"/"chi_sim"); override test uses throw-after-record to prove override beats config via lastOcrLanguage(). Minor proxy: EXPECT_FALSE(hocr.empty()) paired with the language assertion.
STRONG. Asserts exact emitted content-stream operator bytes (Tm offsets, marker, escaping). One flaw: JustifyEmitsTw (191) is defeated by substring aliasing — find(" Tw\n") matches "0 Tw\n".

Save/restore byte roundtrips decent. But headline ReconstructCommand/ImageReplaceCommand ExecuteAndUndo (257,327) tolerate a silent no-op and only compare image-data SIZE. SaveImageXObjectRef/SaveContentsRef ReturnsValue (161,171) have zero EXPECT.
STRONG unit tests of provenance predicates gating invisible-OCR vs visible-vector routing; exact boolean outputs for known font-name inputs, good edge coverage.
Exact EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ against independent hand-computed constants for geometry/confidence math. Default-value tests are pure change-detectors but legitimate value-object coverage.

MIXED. Rotation-0/90/180/270 tests correctly call the product mapper with hand-derived numbers (strong). But the comment-labelled 'critical' Y-flip-fix tests (NoYFlip_*, PixelRectToPdf/PdfRectToPixel_SimpleRect at 161,176,191,210) recompute the mapping with the test's OWN arithmetic and never invoke the mapper — cannot catch the exact regression they name.

isImageDominated bool tests + TileRenderer sequence-counter tests are good. But the 15 ImageCommandsDirtyTest cases (Insert/Remove/Resize/Rotate/Crop x exec/undo/redo) assert ONLY that createDisplayList()!=nullptr — blind to whether the visual image edit happened. Routing tests are widget-exists (textEditTool()!=null).

STRONG. Asserts exact round-tripped language codes ("fra", "eng+fra", whitespace->"eng" fallback) through real dialog OK-click + settings reread; persisted code IS the truth. Only PreferencesDialogExposesCombo is structural.

No test asserts a KNOWN query returns KNOWN hits. Positive path is totalMatches()>=0 (always true — returns int size_t) and hit-structure loops are vacuous when hits is empty. Broken search stays green.

Approach-selection boundary tests (B vs C) meaningful, but PerfectScore/BorderlineScore/CustomThresholdsRespected hand-recompute expected scores with the SAME weighting formula the code uses — a wrong weight propagates identically.

STRONG. BOM asserted byte-exact (0xEF/0xBB/0xBF), form-feeds==pageCount-1, action enable/disable. Extraction IS the export truth. ContentMatchesPageExtractPlainText is circular (compares to same extractPlainText) but byte/separator tests carry the file.

MIXED. ColorPersistsThroughSaveAndReopen (243) is exemplary — renders and counts red pixels>50 (true visual). But ApplyEditWithColor/BlackColorDoesNotCrash (150,177) only no-throw; SearchPanel block is widget-exists + signal-emission.
OcrOnScannedPdf asserts hocr non-empty + blocks>0 but never that a KNOWN word was recognized — gibberish passes. RenderPageAt300Dpi comment predicts ~2550x3300 yet asserts only >100.

In-memory queue/snapshot contract asserts exact alignment enum + page index (solid). But FlushAppliesPendingBlocks (154) — the only end-to-end test — greps extractPlainText() for a marker; Left/Center/Right/Justify all pass identically. FlushWithEmptyQueue only checks pageCount.

STRONG. Exact QRectF geometry via EXPECT_FLOAT_EQ for press/move/release, inverted-coord normalization, min-size gating, wrong-button rejection. Selection rect IS the output. Only paint-overlay/no-callback are no-throw.

native->true / scanned->false routing on real fixtures is meaningful. TextExtractorHasText_Delegates (75) compares two impls that delegate to each other (can't fail independently); TessdataFixtureExists just checks a file exists.

STRONG. Boolean AND/OR/NOT, phrase-adjacency, prefix, ranking order (p1 before p0), upsert-replace, reopen-persistence all assert specific pages match/exclude. Text search IS the truth. Perf budget deliberately loose.

Reconstruction writes NEW glyphs into the content stream but nothing renders/re-extracts the produced PDF. Nearly every assertion is guarded by if(result.success); a mutation flipping success to false makes the body vanish while the test passes. Tautologies at 183-188 (bg: isUniform||...||neither) and 212-213 (font: empty||!empty).

Up/Down key-accept (434) and textEdited-callback tests are genuine behavior oracles. Lifecycle/PaintOverlayNoCrash (393) are pure no-crash — the painted QImage is created but never inspected for geometry/pixels.

STRONGEST OCR file. Independent Levenshtein WER/CER vs committed golden sidecar; EXPECT_LE(wer,0.15) (295) with a self-check EXPECT_GE(wer(garbage),1.0) (269) proving it kills garbage. Real accuracy oracle.

Confirms text present + structurally shaped, never specific expected text/positions. CharacterPositions asserts EXPECT_GE(quad.width(),0.0) (110) which cannot fail for any real quad — collapsed/degenerate quads pass. PlainTextMatchesStructured asserts both non-empty, not that they match.

Edits the CONTENT STREAM (core visual mutation) yet ApplySimpleEdit/PreserveUnmodifiedText only assert blocksAfter.size()>0 — never that 'X' appears at the right place/upright/color, nor that neighbours are byte-identical. Two MuPdfFzAlwaysInvariant tests (347,388) are strong but test setjmp mechanics, not output. ConstructorDestructor is SUCCEED().

Decent widget test: DisplaysOcrText (66) EXPECT_EQ(toPlainText, expected); approach-selection threshold tests assert real branching. ConstructAndDestroy ends in redundant SUCCEED() but has a prior EXPECT.
Undo/redo can-state round-trips + merge-id behavior are genuine. ExecuteCallsApplyEdits (224) is misnamed — only EXPECT_NO_THROW(execute()), never proves applyEdits was called or changed anything.

STRONGEST structural file. Synthetic fixtures, exact expected span text/indices (EXPECT_EQ(U"Hello",span.text) at 95) and hit-testing (EXPECT_EQ(2,charIndex) at 335). Fully deterministic, no render dependency.

Verifies font family/size/bold PURELY via stext fontName/fontSize after reopen — blind to whether glyphs render, are upright/colored/positioned. BoldToggleReachesContentStream (266) passes on ANY font-name change (nameMentionsBold||nameDiffers).

STRONG. Literal-font-name tests assert exact displayed text (EXPECT_EQ(combo->currentText(),"Alef") at 262) — the real user-visible value. Signal-guard tests flush the event loop before counting. *Exists tests also check min-width/range/checkable.

STRONG — the model the others fail to meet. Reads argb via fitz stext after inject+reopen: EXPECT_NE(aligned.argb,0xFFFFFF) (98) + EXPECT_EQ(0x000000) (100) catch the invisible-white leak; neighbor-unchanged oracle (114) guards collateral damage.

STRONG. EXPECT_NE(text.find("REPLACED"),npos) AND EXPECT_EQ(text.find("Page"),npos) after save/reopen (69,71) assert both halves. Extraction is legitimate — find/replace is a text-content feature, not visual.

HIGHEST-YIELD no-oracle file. Feature is VISUAL glyph width scaling; not one test asserts any width/matrix/geometry. CharRatioLogic (164) recomputes oldLen/newLen and asserts it equals oldLen/newLen (calls zero product code). Six *NoException tests + a SUCCEED (267).

Comments self-incriminate ('just verify no crash', 'verify API works'). The user-visible truth (selected text==what's under the rubber-band; quads cover it) is only checked behind if(!empty) guards — an all-empty regression passes green.

Reasonably strong. EXPECT_TRUE(args.at(3).toBool())/args.at(2) (179,181) verify the live selectionFormattingChanged bold/italic payload, not merely widget existence. Minor redundancy between two helper tests.

Best of the render tests — actually renders onPaintOverlay and samples pixels. But the predicate counts ANY non-white pixel as highlight (164: c!=qRgb(255,255,255)) without confirming the semi-transparent blue or position — a stray caret/glyph pixel satisfies it. Catches invisible-highlight, misses wrong-color/wrong-position.

Idempotency/remove via countOccurrences are legitimate content checks, but the feature's point — is the text ALIGNED (left/center/right), visible, on-page — is never asserted. Left vs Center vs Right produce identical passing extraction.

fileContainsAlignMarker (44,125) proves a %%PDFE-ALIGN comment byte-sequence is present, not that any glyph rendered visibly/aligned. MainWindowOwnsAlignmentPipeline (183) is EXPECT_NO_THROW + objectName()=="mainWindow".

Checks glyph-index correctness (NOT a proxy). EXPECT_NE(p.emitted,hex4(cp)) (105) independently pins the raw-codepoint-as-GID bug and is not tautological. The EXPECT_EQ(gid) half (99) may be circular if encodeGlyphIndicesHex shares fz_encode_character. Does not render.

More than no-crash: EXPECT_NE(text.find("ABC"),npos) (57) verifies displayed glyphs win over /ActualText. Weakness: no assertion that the wrong override text is absent. Crash-regression value real (fixture reproduces the abort).

Strong render-path ink-bbox flip (459-464: EXPECT_GT(vb.height(),vb.width())) is real geometry. Weak spot: ArabicShaping joining (146-155) sets sawPositionalForm if any glyph id absent from nominal cmap — verifies substitution happened, not that it was CORRECT (garbage gids also pass).

File named 'performance' asserts ZERO timing. SearchPage_FindsText (56): EXPECT_GE(totalMatches(),0) is always true (returns int hits.size()); only real assert is query non-empty. Quad checks (104) are in a for-loop that is vacuous when hits empty.

Solid command-contract oracle: independent re-derivation of processed/invalidated page sets via fake callbacks, exact set equality. Real Tesseract stubbed by design (acceptable scope limit). DescriptionIsStable is trivial.

Per-run VISUAL Tf/font emission verified only by save->reopen distinct-fontSize count (EXPECT_GE(fontSizes.size(),2) at 229). Admits streams are FlateDecode so byte-search 'couldn't work'; wrong glyphs/position/mirror/white all still yield >=2 sizes. One contract DISABLED (353-381).

MIXED. Escaping/MiniZip-magic tests are true (exact bytes). But DOCX/RTF body content is never validated against source PDF text (substring presence of <w:body> etc). BoldIsEmittedWhenFontNameImpliesBold (207) asserts only <w:document present — nothing about bold.

Text edit->undo->original round-trips are legitimate (extraction is truth for text content). But UndoPreservesFormattingRunsBaseline (292) is SUCCEED() on the exact UI-TE-UNDO-01 formatting-drop regression it names. Undo tests use 'text appears somewhere on page 0' (pageContainsSpanText) — blind to wrong span/position/duplication.
STRONG. Exact field-by-field equality on SubstitutionInfo from buildSubstitutionFromFormattingRuns; pure data-transform helper with independent expected values, no visual claim to be blind to.

STRONG. Hybrid-path==full-scan parity incl. exact quad geometry (EXPECT_NEAR 1e-3) + pseudo page-set checks. Quad-equality is real user-visible truth. HundredPage<50ms (340) is env-dependent (false-red flake risk) but also asserts correctness.
STRONG. Exact caret-line/selection-rect coordinates (EXPECT_NEAR 1e-3) for vertical + RTL geometry, with a documented re-red mutation. Asserts the exact visual geometry the overlay consumes.
STRONG. Exact structured-data equality (bbox coords, text, confidence, codepoints, char distribution). Parsing structured data with exact expected values — extraction IS the truth for a parser.

CopyAfterSelectAll (169) has a real EXPECT_EQ(clipboardText,spanText). But PasteWithEmptyClipboard (373) ends in SUCCEED() and CopyWithNoSelection (311-317) reduces to EXPECT_FALSE(empty)+NO_THROW. Cut/Paste assert callback-fired only.

ApplyTextColorWithCaretRecolorsWholeSpan (138-146) asserts color landed in internal formattingRuns struct, NOT a rendered pixel — blind to whether color actually renders. HasEnabledColorButton (162-173) is pure widget-exists. But CtrlAWhileEditingSelectsSpan (247-253) is a genuine behavioral oracle.

STRONG. Asserts the leaked state's VISUAL effect not a flag: baseline shift from ambient 50 Ts via EXPECT_NEAR(shop.firstBaselineY,orig.firstBaselineY,5.0) (130), non-mirror (136), neighbour argb (193) + baseline (195). One test is a documented refutation but still carries a mirror oracle.

MIXED. looksLikeNumber/columnLetter (46-76) are exact-value true oracles. But end-to-end tests only check zip magic PK + substring-presence of part names/<sheetData> in raw bytes (106-113) — never that any actual PDF cell VALUE reached the sheet. Empty/garbled sheets pass.

SEED CONFIRMED STRONG. Reads back edited glyphs via fitz stext after save/reopen. Color: EXPECT_GT(r,0x60)+EXPECT_NEAR(r,0xDB,24) (123-128). Mirror: EXPECT_GT(q.ur.x,q.ul.x) (140) + run-direction (144). Genuine user-visible oracle.

MultiplePageEdits (236-237) ends with a 'without crash' comment and ZERO assertions. SaveAfterEdit (247,275-296) explicitly declines content verification — only EXPECT_NO_THROW(save)+reopen+non-empty. UndoRedoCycle/DirtyFlag assert only can-undo/isClean flags, no content.

SEED CONFIRMED STRONG. Glyph-quad + pixel-ink hard asserts under ambient N-up CTM: upright EXPECT_GT(inj.firstUrx,inj.firstUlx) (187), visible EXPECT_GT(ink,60) (192), size band EXPECT_GT(ratio,0.80)/LT(1.20) normalized to KEEPME (197-201), on-page bounds. Promotes the half-size-under-imposed-CTM bug to a red test.

PROMPT GUESS DID NOT HOLD — NOT strong. Filename says 'render' but NO pixels are rendered. Every oracle is extractPlainText().find(newTok)!=npos && find(oldTok)==npos (96-101,131-134,159-162). Catches total no-op; blind to the edit landing mirrored/wrong-color/wrong-size/off-page/wrong-glyph.

Replacement-appears/original-gone via extractPlainText (129,159,203-205,263). TextPositionPreserved uses EXPECT_NEAR(newBBox.width(),origWidth,origWidth*0.5) (318) — a 50% tolerance asserting almost nothing. No pixel/quad/mirror/color.
STRONG. Mirror via q.ur.x>q.ul.x (61,112); neighbour integrity via changed-pixel bounding-box EXPECT_LT(boxArea,pageArea*15/100) with changed>50 floor (170-178). Real pixel-diff localization oracle.

ACCEPTABLE UAF regression. ASSERT_NO_THROW(undo()) (180) is the crash oracle, but ALSO asserts content restoration via exact model.span(i).text==wanted (92,183). Blind to visual position/mirror of restored text.

MIXED. Oracle 1 asserts exact restored dimensions EXPECT_EQ(restored->width,origWidth) (191-194) — real. Oracle 2 asserts only EXPECT_FALSE(restoredData.empty()) after undo (327) — 'an image exists', not that the ORIGINAL content came back; heavily tessdata-gated.

MODERATE (prompt guess overstated). Orientation EXPECT_NEAR(editedBBox.y(),origBBox.y(),5.0) (137) + size ratio 0.90-1.10 (146-149) catch Tm.d sign flip and Tfs scale. But glyph correctness is extraction-find only (122) and nothing checks ur.x>ul.x — a pure horizontal mirror preserving bbox could slip. Second TEST_F heavily GTEST_SKIP-gated.

STRONG for its domain (extraction IS the feature). Column-major reading order cross-checked against real geometry (203,235); ligature ASCII decomposition with U+FB00-06 negative check (277-286); table row/col geometry (471-492); hyphen terminal-glyph EXPECT_EQ(codepoint,0x2D) (681). Only soft spot: RtlScripts presence-count tolerant (342).

SEED CONFIRMED STRONG. Mirror EXPECT_GT(inj.firstUrx,inj.firstUlx) (212), visibility pixel-ink EXPECT_GT(ink,60) (216), size band 0.80-1.20 normalized to KEEPME (220-224), on-page bounds (228-231), idempotency via countGuardStreams (278). Strongest injector file.

ranked_weak_findings.test: ImageCommandsDirtyTest.* (15 cases: Insert/Remove/Resize/Rotate/Crop x exec/undo/redo; reps 314,367,417,470,533)
ranked_weak_findings.user_visible_failure_missed: Image insert/remove/resize/rotate/crop are all VISUAL, yet the only oracle is createDisplayList()!=nullptr. A command that no-ops, inserts at the wrong rect/size, rotates the wrong way, crops the wrong region, or an undo that fails to revert — the page still builds a display list, so all 15 stay green. No pixels, geometry, XObject presence, or dirty-state verified.

Replaces a span's first char with 'X', then asserts only EXPECT_NO_THROW + blocksAfter.size()>0. The editor writing the wrong glyph, dropping the edit, mirroring the text, emitting it white/invisible, corrupting position, or clobbering/recoloring NEIGHBOUR spans (the exact shipped ambient-state-leak bug class) — all pass, because the page 'still has some text'.

Feature is glyph horizontal-width scaling. CharRatioLogic recomputes charRatio=oldLen/newLen and asserts it equals oldLen/newLen — calls zero product code. If EditTextCommand's width math were inverted/dropped/clamped (text at half/double width, overlapping or spilling off-line), every assertion here passes. The six *NoException tests read back no Tz/matrix/width/geometry.

Reconstruction writes NEW glyphs into the page content stream (visual). All meaningful assertions are inside if(result.success) and only check originalText/editedText non-empty + bbox w/h>0. Nothing renders/re-extracts the produced PDF. A reconstructor writing wrong/garbage/mirrored/invisible text, or a mutation flipping success to false, passes.

MultiplePageEdits has ZERO assertions after the edits ('without crash' comment) — an edit that no-ops, lands wrong glyphs/position, or corrupts the other page passes. SaveAfterEdit explicitly declines content verification (line 247) and only checks save didn't throw + reopen yields non-empty blocks — a saved PDF dropping/garbling/mirroring/off-page-writing the edit passes.

The ONE end-to-end test of an inherently VISUAL feature (text alignment). The injector could write every block Left-aligned when Center/Right was requested, off-page, or invisible — extractPlainText().find(marker) still succeeds, so it passes. No geometry/x-offset/render oracle exists.

Left/Center/Right alignment is the feature, but only extractPlainText().find(...) is checked. Text drawn left when it should be centered, positioned off-page, white/invisible, or with a leaked CTM all extract identically and pass. MultipleBlocksOnDifferentPages proves presence, never position.

Bold oracle is EXPECT_TRUE(nameMentionsBold || nameDiffers) (266): any font-name change for an unrelated reason (subset prefix, substitution, resource rename) passes as 'bold survived' even if strokes aren't heavier. Font family/size verified only via stext metadata — a correct Tf reference with glyphs rendered invisible/mirrored/white/off-page reports the right font regardless.

Search returning ZERO hits for text actually on the fixture is invisible: BasicSearch asserts only totalMatches()>=0 (a tautology — returns size_t) and the hit-structure/quad-geometry checks live inside for(hit:result.hits) loops that run zero times when empty. Broken indexing/highlight-quads stay green.

File named 'performance' asserts NO timing. Verified: totalMatches() returns int hits.size(), so EXPECT_GE(...,0) is always true. Only real assert is query non-empty. Search returning zero hits for present text, or case-insensitive returning different sets for 'test' vs 'TEST', passes. Quad checks are in a vacuous loop.

These are the comment-labelled 'critical' tests for the Y-flip regression. Each computes the mapping with the test's OWN arithmetic (e.g. pixY=(fitzTopLeft.y-tf.translateY)/tf.scaleY) and asserts on that — never calls mapper_->pdfToPixel / pixelRectToPdf. If the PRODUCT mapper inverts Y (a scanned-text selection lands on the opposite end of the page), the test cannot fail.

Reconstructing text onto a scanned page is visual. execute() is wrapped in EXPECT_NO_THROW; the comment concedes it 'may succeed or fail gracefully'; the only post-state check is image-data SIZE equality after undo. A command that silently does nothing, writes the wrong text, positions it wrong, or an undo restoring a same-size-but-different image all pass.

Per-run font/size emission is visual; oracle is distinct extracted-font-size count (EXPECT_GE(fontSizes.size(),2)). Per-run text rendered with wrong glyphs, wrong X/Y, mirrored, white/invisible, overlapping, or off-page all still yield >=2 distinct extracted sizes and pass. Emitted operators never inspected (streams FlateDecode-compressed).

Test name claims bold coverage; the final assert is EXPECT_NE(bytes.find("<w:document"),npos) — a structural shell check unrelated to bold. Bold never emitted into the DOCX (heuristic-to-<w:b/> wiring broken) passes; comment admits 'cannot assert the specific markup'.
Body ends in SUCCEED() ('Soft-asserting'). Undo dropping formatting runs (a blank/de-formatted line) — precisely the UI-TE-UNDO-01 bug named in the test's own header — cannot fail this test.

Edited text rendered mirrored, invisible, white-on-white, wrong size, wrong color, or off-page — extraction-present (find(...)!=npos) sees the codepoints regardless of how/whether they render. The visual correctness of the edit is unverified.

OCR's user-visible truth is the RECOGNIZED TEXT. hocr non-empty + blocks>0 passes even when OCR mis-recognizes the page into gibberish; no assertion checks a KNOWN word from the scanned fixture appears in the hOCR.

Despite the 'render' filename, no pixels are rendered — oracle is extractPlainText().find. Misses the small-text edit landing mirrored, wrong-color, wrong-position, wrong-glyph, or off-page (only detects a total no-op).

Text-color is a visual property; the oracle inspects the internal formattingRuns struct, never a rendered pixel/argb. The color can be recorded correctly in the model yet not actually render (serialization/render break) and the test passes.
Asserts only PK zip-magic + part-name/<sheetData> substring presence. Sheets exported structurally valid but EMPTY or with garbled/wrong cell values (no PDF-derived value reaches the sheet) pass.

EXPECT_GE(ch.quad.width(),0.0) / height()>=0.0 accept zero — a mutation collapsing every character quad to zero area (all glyphs stacked at a point / degenerate positioning, breaking selection & highlight) passes. Only fontSize>0 is a real check.

PreservesRendering asserts only pageCount()>0 — if BDC injection corrupts the content stream so the page renders blank/garbled, page count is unaffected. MultipleRegions asserts only pageHasMarkedContent==true — a tagger emitting P where H1 was requested, dropping regions, or wrong MCIDs (wrong document structure / reading order for assistive tech) passes.

Checks bbox y/height stability (catches Tm.d sign flip and Tfs scale) but never asserts glyph direction (ur.x>ul.x). A pure horizontal mirror that preserves bbox height and y slips through; glyph correctness is extraction-present only (122).

Intends to prove non-last lines get positive word-spacing, but body.find(" Tw\n") is a substring of "0 Tw\n" (the leading space). If the justifier is broken and emits 0 Tw on every line, both finds succeed — fully un-justified text (renders left-aligned) passes green.

The real checks (selected text == region text; quads cover the glyphs) are wrapped in if(!isEmpty) guards / empty-loops. A regression where selection silently returns empty text or zero quads for a text-bearing region passes because the assertions are skipped.

The color edit could drop the rg operator, mirror the text, or apply the wrong color — it produces wrong output without throwing, so both pass. (Mitigated at file level by ColorPersistsThroughSaveAndReopen:243 which counts red pixels — but these two contribute zero oracle value.)
Comment states expected ~2550x3300, but the assertion is >100 on each axis. A DPI regression (renders at 72 DPI ~612x792, or a thumbnail) passes, silently degrading OCR input quality.

sawPositionalForm is set if any shaped glyph id is absent from the isolated-cmap nominal set — verifies substitution happened, not that it was CORRECT. Shaping emitting wrong positional forms or garbage gids (also not in nominal set) passes; joined Arabic could render incorrectly.

The predicate counts ANY pixel != qRgb(255,255,255) as the selection highlight without confirming semi-transparent blue or correct sub-region. A stray caret line, anti-aliased glyph, or a highlight painted in the wrong color/offset registers hits>0. Catches invisible-highlight, misses wrong-color/wrong-position.
Despite the name, only EXPECT_NO_THROW({cmd.execute();}) — execute() silently not calling applyEdits, or applying nothing, has no spy or state check to catch it.
Zero EXPECT/ASSERT despite the 'ReturnsValue' name; comment says 'expect a non-null image reference' but never checks it. saveImageXObjectRef returning null (breaking undo capture) passes silently.

EXPECT_TRUE(isUniform||hasGradient||isComplex||(!isUniform&&!hasGradient&&!isComplex)) is true for every combination of three bools; EXPECT_TRUE(fontFamily.empty()||!fontFamily.empty()) is a pure tautology. Any/garbage background or font classification passes.

Asserts glyphs.size()==5 and xAdvance>0. Wrong glyph IDs (renders wrong characters) or wrong advances (overlapping/spread text) both pass — nothing compares to expected glyph indices or metric-accurate advances.

PasteWithEmptyClipboard ends in SUCCEED() and only guards against a crash; a paste that corrupts span text or mis-fires the callback passes. CopyWithNoSelection reduces to EXPECT_FALSE(empty)+NO_THROW.

The EXPECT_EQ(p.emitted,hex4(p.gid)) expected value is derived from fz_encode_character; if encodeGlyphIndicesHex maps cp->gid via the same MuPDF call this half is circular and misses a systematic shared mis-mapping. Mitigated: the EXPECT_NE(...,hex4(cp)) at 105 independently pins the real historical bug.

Cache test asserts only isNull-parity and (conditionally) equal size ('Either way, if we get a result, caching should work'); a cache returning a different/corrupt glyph on the 2nd call passes. StrokeWeight_NoOp asserts only result.size()==glyph.size() — a same-size blank/garbage image passes; pixels never compared.

After undo the page carries SOME image but not necessarily the ORIGINAL (wrong dimensions/content) — Oracle 2 asserts only !restoredData.empty(). Impact limited: Oracle 1 (191) covers dims deterministically.
Asserts only that a call doesn't throw and the window objectName()=="mainWindow". Any alignment-persistence defect is invisible.

Asserts displayed 'ABC' is present but never that the /ActualText override is correctly ignored (a result that also leaked the override text as a separate run still contains 'ABC' and passes). Crash-regression coverage itself is sound.
